title: Should you + 動詞原形
titleZh: 「Should you + 動詞原形」正式條件倒裝句
titleEn: Using Should you for formal conditional inversion

source.file: Sentence Structure 152 -「Should you + 動詞原形」正式條件倒裝句.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Should + you + base verb + other information, + main clause

formulas.formula: Should + you + base verb + other information, + main clause

example: Should you need help, let me know.
exampleZh: 如你需要協助，請告訴我。

examples.en: Should you need help, let me know.
examples.zh: 如你需要協助，請告訴我。
examples.highlight: Should you need help, let me know.

rules.zh: 把 should 移到 you 前面後，便要刪去 if。
rules.en: Do not use “if” together with the inverted structure After moving should before you, remove if. Should you need help, contact us. If should you need help, contact us.
examples: Should you need help, contact us.
If should you need help, contact us.

rules.zh: “Should” does not mean 「應該」 here 在這個句型中，should 並不是表示「應該」，而是提出一個可能發生的情況，意思與 if 相近。 （如果你見到彼得，請把這封信交給他。） 這句並不是說你「應該去見彼得」。
rules.en: “Should” does not mean “ought to” here. In this structure, should introduces a possible condition and has a meaning similar to if. Should you see Peter, give him this letter means “If you see Peter ...”; it does not mean that you ought to see Peter.
examples: In this structure, should introduces a possible condition. It is similar to if.
Should you see Peter, give him this letter.
The sentence does not mean that you ought to see Peter.

rules.zh: 主語後面的動詞必須使用原形。
rules.en: Use the base form after “should” The verb immediately after the subject must be in its base form. Should you need help, ... Should you have a question, ... Should you be unable to attend, ... Should you require more information, ... Should you needs help, ... Should you needed help, ... Should you are unable to attend, ...
examples: The verb immediately after the subject must be in its base form.
Should you need help, ...
Should you have a question, ...
Should you be unable to attend, ...
Should you require more information, ...
Should you needs help, ...
Should you needed help, ...
Should you are unable to attend, ...

rules.zh: 否定條件要把 not 放在主語後面。 （如你沒有收到我們的電郵，請查看垃圾郵件資料夾。）
rules.en: Negative conditions use “Should you not…” Place not after the subject. Should you not receive our email, check your spam folder. Do not write: Should not you receive our email, ...
examples: Should you not receive our email, check your spam folder.
Should not you receive our email, ...

rules.zh: 如要表示某件事情可能已經發生，可以使用： （如你已忘記密碼，請使用重設連結。） （如你仍未收到包裹，請聯絡快遞公司。）
rules.en: Earlier completed situations may use “Should you have + past participle” To refer to something that may already have happened, use: Should + you + have + past participle Should you have forgotten your password, use the reset link. Should you not have received the parcel, contact the courier.
examples: Earlier completed situations may use “Should you have + past participle”
Should + you + have + past participle
Should you have forgotten your password, use the reset link.
Should you not have received the parcel, contact the courier.

rules.zh: Should you… 常見於： 正式電郵； 顧客服務訊息； 通告； 指示； 申請文件； 合約及正式文件。 在一般日常對話中，使用 If you… 通常更常見。
rules.en: This structure is more formal than an ordinary if-sentence. Should you ... is common in formal emails, customer-service messages, notices, instructions, applications, contracts and official documents. In ordinary conversation, If you ... is usually more common.
examples: formal emails;
customer-service messages;
notices;
instructions;
applications;
contracts and official documents.
In ordinary conversation, If you… is usually more common.

rules.zh: 當句子以 Should you… 開始時，要在主要句子前加上逗號。
rules.en: Use a comma when the conditional clause comes first When the sentence begins with Should you…, place a comma before the main clause. Should you require assistance, please contact reception.
examples: Should you require assistance, please contact reception.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以禮貌地提出一個可能出現的問題或需要，避免語氣過於直接。 （如你有任何疑慮，請與老師商討。）
benefits.en: It helps you express a condition politely The structure allows you to mention a possible problem or need without sounding too direct. Should you have any concerns, please speak to your teacher.
examples: The structure allows you to mention a possible problem or need without sounding too direct.
Should you have any concerns, please speak to your teacher.

benefits.zh: 撰寫給顧客、同事、學校或機構的正式電郵時，你可以直接運用這個句型。 （如你需要進一步資料，請聯絡本辦事處。）
benefits.en: It is useful in formal emails and notices You can use this ready-made structure when writing to customers, colleagues, schools or organisations. Should you require further information, please contact our office.
examples: Should you require further information, please contact our office.

benefits.zh: 你不需要每個條件句都使用 if。使用 Should you… 可以增加句式變化，避免文章顯得重複。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to repeatedly using “if” Instead of beginning every condition with if, you can use Should you… to create sentence variety. Compare: If you need assistance, contact us. Should you need assistance, contact us.
examples: If you need assistance, contact us.
Should you need assistance, contact us.

benefits.zh: 這個句型先交代可能出現的情況，讀者之後便能更容易理解相關指示、建議或結果。 （如你錯過尾班車，請乘搭通宵巴士。）
benefits.en: It places the possible situation clearly at the beginning The reader understands the possible condition before reading the instruction, advice or result. Should you miss the last train, use the night bus.
examples: The reader understands the possible condition before reading the instruction, advice or result.
Should you miss the last train, use the night bus.

benefits.zh: 這個句型尤其適合用於申請文件、職場溝通、顧客服務回覆及正式指示，使內容顯得更有條理。
benefits.en: It makes formal writing sound controlled and well organised This structure is especially useful in applications, workplace communication, customer-service replies and official instructions.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.
